name: Najeon chilgi card case
where: National Museum of Korea gift shop or a craft specialty shop in Insadong
about: A small card holder decorated with mother-of-pearl inlay on lacquered wood. It shows Korean craft design and has long been made in Seoul.
tip: Check that the mother-of-pearl pieces and the lacquer finish are smooth and even.

name: Traditional bojagi wrapping cloth
about: A Korean wrapping cloth used to carry gifts and goods. It is a classic piece of Korean textile tradition.
tip: Know the fabric type: ramie, cotton, or synthetic fiber each feels and cares for differently.

name: Seoul Samhae Soju
where: Samhae Soju seller or a traditional liquor specialty shop
about: A traditional distilled liquor from Seoul. It is a local spirit tied to the city's drinking culture.
tip: Compare the retail price with the bottle price at a glass-pour bar, since they differ.
